description.blurb: Eggther (formerly S/2004 S27 and Saturn LIX) is the outermost known natural satellite of Saturn, discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: In mythology, Eggther is a Norse giant and the watchman who announces the beginning of Ragnarok. Eggther is about 6 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1054.45 days, at an inclination of 168° to the ecliptic.
